title: E. Gaynor Brennan Golf Course
specs: Municipal golf course in Stamford, CT
No juniors under 7 years old allowed to play on the golf course
Juniors 13 and under must play with an adult
Each player must have their own clubs
Tournaments require minimum 80 or 100 players and a $1000 deposit
includes: Cart rental available for $19 per rider for 18 holes, $14 per rider for 9 holes
Cart included in Monday tournament fees
gap: Exact duration of rounds not stated
blurb: Guests play golf on a municipal course with options for 9 or 18 holes. Cart rentals are available for an additional fee. The course hosts tournaments and offers resident permits for advance booking and discounts.
extraNote: Players must check-in 15 minutes before their tee time · Cancellation policies apply for weekend & holiday and regular weekday tee times; may be waived for inclement weather · No-shows for resident permit holders result in permit suspension until payment is made · No-shows for non-residents require payment before next tee time
